description: This file defines an interface for configuration related to the AWS SDK's use of dual-stack endpoints. It specifies methods to check if dual-stack endpoints are enabled and to retrieve the configuration as an array.

classes.name: ConfigurationInterface
classes.description: Interface defining configuration options for using dual-stack endpoints in AWS SDK

methods.name: isUseDualstackEndpoint
methods.description: Returns whether or not to use a DUALSTACK endpoint

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the configuration as an associative array
